details:
While this is super specific to a set group of people I feel like a system that allows users to speak to someone from far away would be very useful.

Quite often me and my friends will be playing within maps that are very large and/or have features that separate us from each other (intentional or not) where we can no longer speak to each other or communicate without resorting to an outside service such as and instant messaging service or social media platform.

The issue with this, is that it means I, and other people like me would have to add every individual we play the game with on outside platforms which would be a nightmare as my and many other people's friends lists are very long and many users like to completely cut away from the game when they're not playing it.

How this is implemented doesn't really bother me. While a calling system might be a little too much for a quick feature, something like a messaging system for players in the same world would be much easier to create in a short period of time and it can piggyback off systems already in place to function. I've seen maps with a group chat function that allow for unlimited speaking distance between users and I've also seen worlds where every user has a keyboard that can type to others with, which made those huge worlds a lot more fun to explore as I wasn't permanently separated from everyone for over an hour.

While a seemingly small feature, the ability to tell someone something remotely is extremely useful such as "I accidentally moved on without you, I'm in the next room" or "hold on, I died and have to redo this section" is great for preventing players from needing to do things like resetting adventure maps if they get lost. Some adventure maps in this game are upwards of over 5 hours long and often have no methods of saving progress between instances, which could ruin someone's experience with a map if they get separated from their friends and cannot do anything about it without having to add them somewhere else to achieve a form of basic communication.

Not really a "ground breaking innovation" or something that "changes the game forever" but just a small quality of life feature that can help people have a slightly smoother experience in adventure maps and extremely large, open spaces.
title: A system to speak and/or communicate to users outside your speaking range
